claims.statement: For the explicit 2-component systematic field-cube product over binary modulus X^500+X^21+X^13+X^8+1, with the radius-68 systematic candidate decoder in proof.md for each component, the uniform-message average block error for 1000 information bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 217291140745594743/1000000000000000000.

The bsc-ops-v1 program for the same field-cube product and its same component decoder uses at most the integer W=259753505320017716754710098403799263417077884345673559048182244600343914703951546032208122 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(297029/1000).

experiments.purpose: Verify the field modulus, exact component occupancy and combined block-error bound, memory and integer exponent inequality, and sample window-arithmetic identities.
